notes: 503B outsourcing-facility warning letter framed around loss of the section 503B exemption (unlabeled established drug names, missed adverse-event reporting) plus extensive 21 CFR 211 CGMP citations for sterile drug production (aseptic-technique/disinfection failures, an ISO 5 microbial contamination finding, inadequate environmental monitoring, and a computer-systems access-control failure under 211.68(b), treated here as data_integrity). Classified as 'compounding' rather than cgmp_sterile because the letter's legal framing is built around the 503B outsourcing-facility conditions throughout. Because the products lost their 503B exemption, the letter explicitly charges unapproved_new_drug in a dedicated section (unlike most compounding letters). Voluntary recalls of sterile drug products were initiated due to lack of sterility assurance, so recall_concern is true and contamination_present is true (actual ISO 5 microbial contamination recovered). No FEI is stated; products list is the seven drug products named in the labeling-deficiency finding (section B.1).
